create_event_tracer: create an EventTracer context manager to calculate elapsed times of functions annotated with event_scope
test_event_scope: test the event_scope decorator that wraps a function and records a Warp event before and after invocation
run_cache_kernel: run the cache_kernel decorator to cache Warp kernels by argument size and function name to avoid graph_conditional crashes
review_check_toolkit_driver: review the check_toolkit_driver function that initializes Warp and warns if CUDA version is below 12.4
build_scoped_mathdx_gemm_disabled: build a scoped_mathdx_gemm_disabled context manager to temporarily disable Warp MathDx GEMM kernels
